prompt: Implement ParseHuman in duration.go. It parses human-written durations made of one or more integer+unit terms, where the units are d (24 hours), h, m and s, for example "1h30m", "45s", "2d", "1d 2h 3m 4s". Terms may be separated by spaces and the input may have surrounding whitespace. Return the total as a time.Duration. Return ErrInvalidDuration for an empty string, a term with no number, no unit, an unknown unit, a negative sign, or any other garbage. Do not change the function signature.
